title: The 2022 Specialized S-Works Crux Is Worth Robbing A Bank For! Long-term review

takeaways.text: Derived from the Aethos, the frame keeps round tubes, non-dropped stays, external seat clamp and threaded bottom bracket at a claimed 725 g.
His size-56 S-Works build weighed 7.25 kg without pedals, lighter than his Giant TCR Advanced road bike.
Clearance grows from about 36–38 mm on the old cyclocross Crux to 47 mm, with a slightly longer, slacker, lower geometry that still leans racy for a gravel bike.
Very fast and quick to accelerate on twisting trails thanks to the low weight and stiff frame, though he does not think it matches an aero gravel bike on fast open gravel.

disclosure: How the bike was supplied is not stated; the 2022 S-Works Crux shown uses the same FACT 12r frame and SRAM Red XPLR-style build as the 2024 model.
summary: A two-month review of the 2022 S-Works Crux, the current-generation frame before the 2026 Crux 5.
